items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I was playing with a territory band down south. I was 16 or 17 years old. Dean Hudson.

ctx.x: By golly. Yeah they have a hell of a record. So that, and there are several dynamite service bands.

Yeah, I guess now you either go in the service or you go to college. When we were young you’d go out on the road with some band. That’s the first time I saw Tommy Newsom arrangements. I was playing with a territory band down south. I was 16 or 17 years old. Dean Hudson. It was a famous band in its neighborhood. And your friend Johnny Presley was one of the trumpet players, from Virginia. And I’d say, “This is better arrangements than we usually have, where’d you get these?” And he said, “Well my friend, Tommy…
I didn’t know Johnny had that music.
